name: Shawnee Mission School District
districtFact: SMSD does not use one universal first day. Grades 1–7 and 9 begin first, grades 8 and 10–12 begin the next day, and Pre-K and kindergarten start after two conference days. The annual calendar also separates elementary, middle and high-school early-dismissal times.
calendarNotes: Use the annual district PDF for districtwide dates, grade-specific opening days, professional learning, conferences, finals and graduation dates. The opening sequence is staggered: grades 1–7 and 9 attend first; grades 8 and 10–12 begin one day later; Pre-K and kindergarten families have conferences before their first attendance day. Evening conference grade groups differ in fall and spring. In both semesters, the conference schedule is followed by a no-school day for all Pre-K–12 students. Spanish PDFs are official translations of the same schedule, not separate attendance tracks. Building events, conference appointment times, athletics and schedule changes belong to the live district or school calendar. Downloaded ICS files are one-time imports and do not update automatically if SMSD revises a source.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Shawnee Mission students start school on the same day?
districtFaqs.a: No. SMSD uses different first days by grade. Grades 1–7 and 9 begin first, grades 8 and 10–12 begin the next day, and Pre-K and kindergarten begin after two conference days. The annual district calendar provides the dates for each school year.

districtFaqs.q: Are the Shawnee Mission Pre-K and kindergarten conference days regular school days?
districtFaqs.a: No. The annual calendar lists conferences on the two opening days before the first Pre-K and kindergarten attendance day. Families should use their school communication for appointment details.

districtFaqs.q: Do SMSD parent-conference nights cover the same grades in fall and spring?
districtFaqs.a: No. Fall evening conferences are split between grades 7–12 and Pre-K–6. Spring evening conferences are split between grades 9–12 and Pre-K–8. In both fall and spring, the conference schedule is followed by a no-school day for all Pre-K–12 students.

districtFaqs.q: Does Shawnee Mission publish an official Spanish calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. It is an official Spanish translation of the same district schedule, not a separate calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Where should SMSD families check school-specific events?
districtFaqs.a: Use the live district calendar or the student's school calendar for building events, conference appointment times, athletics and later schedule changes. The annual PDF is the source for districtwide school-year dates.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Shawnee Mission ICS file update automatically?
districtFaqs.a: No. It is a one-time import. Check the official SMSD calendar page for revisions, building events and emergency changes.
